title: Maintain Per-Table and Global Maximums
prompt:
Implement TableMaxIndex for online cell updates across named tables. set_cell(table, cell, value) creates or overwrites one integer-valued cell. delete_cell(table, cell) -> bool deletes a present cell and returns whether it existed. table_max(table) -> int | None returns a table's current maximum, or None when that known table has no cells. global_max() -> int | None returns the maximum across every table, or None when no cells remain.

Table and cell names are nonempty strings. Values are ordinary integers, not booleans. set_cell creates a table when needed; querying an unknown table raises ValueError. Aim to avoid rescanning an entire table after every overwrite or deletion by using a max-heap with lazy deletion or an equivalent ordered structure.

This is a practice reconstruction of a reported Notion interview theme: the report asks for efficient updates but does not publish its original cell-operation schema.

example.reasoning: The global result is the largest live cell among all tables.
